description: Parking Purchases (historical) is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by Pittsburgh Parking Authority. This dataset contains transaction-level records of purchases of parking from the Pittsburgh Parking Authority, from Q4 2015 through 2018. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher Pittsburgh Parking Authority. Its tags are parking. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-05-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
